verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents bulk data movement: the Raw Event Export API is recommended for high-volume exports, the Engage API exports user profiles, and Warehouse Connectors sync whole warehouse tables into Mixpanel. JQL and the Query API can also compute over many events, users or cohorts in a single call. These are bulk reads and syncs rather than bulk operations on items, and the MCP server is documented only for querying and single-dashboard creation. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/update actions across many items (e.g. batch profile updates or bulk deletion), bulk actions exposed through the MCP/agent interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.
